summary: purestorage.flasharray and purestorage.flashblade were renamed to everpure.flasharray and everpure.flashblade; old names become redirects in Ansible 15 and are removed in Ansible 17.
questions: What is the new name of purestorage.flasharray?
When will purestorage.flashblade be removed from Ansible?

answer_card.title: purestorage collections renamed to everpure
answer_card.answer_md:
- `purestorage.flasharray` → **`everpure.flasharray`**
- `purestorage.flashblade` → **`everpure.flashblade`**

Both names ship for now. The old collections become deprecated redirects in **Ansible 15.0.0** and are removed in **Ansible 17**. Update your FQCNs.
